Their forces consist of well armed infantry and drones, supported by high tech robots and vehicles. Originally, they emerged from a world long divided into a patchwork society of warring clans. The royal house became adept at manipulating clans, leading potential rivals into a series of destructive wars before imposing their laws over survivors and forming a ruling Dynasty. The Eternal Dynasty will go to any length to maintain this fragile unity as they expand out into the stars. The Eternal Dynasty come from the Kyusa Ri system, meaning the “stars of calm”, due to the enduring peace that the faction enjoyed in their region of the Sirius Sector. This rule doesn’t apply to newly generated attacks. ### Special Rules Ambush Beacon: Friendly units using Ambush may ignore distance restrictions from enemies if they are deployed within 6" of this model. Bounding: When this unit is activated, you may place all models with this rule in it anywhere fully within D3+1" of their position. Casting Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 12" with Caster, which gets +1 to casting rolls once (next time the effect would apply). Fortified: When units where all models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0). Increased Shooting Range Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +6" range when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply). Repel Ambushers: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit. Shielded: Units where all models have this rule get +1 to defense rolls against hits that are not from spells. Shred: On unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound. Surge: On unmodified results of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hits (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules). Tear: Against units where most models have Tough(9) or higher, this weapon gets AP(+4). Teleport: Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 3" of its position when using Advance/Charge actions, or fully within 6" of its position when using Rush actions. Unpredictable Fighter: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead. Vengeance: When this unit is fully destroyed, place as many Vengeance markers on the unit that destroyed it as models with this rule in this unit at the beginning of the game. Friendly units get +X to hit rolls when attacking that unit, where X is the number of markers on it. Versatile Attack: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting or charging enemies over 9" away, all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls. ### Aura Special Rules Clan Warrior Boost Aura: This model and its unit get Clan Warrior Boost. Counter-Attack Aura: This model and its unit get Counter-Attack. Fearless Aura: This model and its unit get Fearless. Ignores Cover Aura: This model and its unit get Ignores Cover when shooting. Melee Evasion Aura: This model and its unit get Melee Evasion. Piercing Hunter Aura: This model and its unit get Piercing Hunter. Precision Fighter Aura: This model and its unit get +1 to hit rolls in melee. Rapid Advance Aura: This model and its unit get Rapid Advance. Rapid Charge Aura: This model and its unit moves +4" when using Charge actions. Stealth Aura: This model and its unit get Stealth. Read more ### Spells Spirit Power (1): Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Flying once (next time the effect would apply). Soul Spear (1): Pick one enemy model within 24", which takes 1 hit with Tear. This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1]. Spirit Resolve (2): Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Clan Warrior Boost once (next time the effect would apply). Mind Vortex (2): Pick up to two enemy units within 12", which take 2 hits with AP(2) each. Eternal Guidance (3): Pick up to three enemy units within 18", which friendly units get +6" range when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply). Dragon Breath (3): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 9 hits. ### Units ### Heroes ONI Captain [1] Qua 3+Def 3+ 95pts Great Mace(A2, Blast(3)), Heavy Bash(A2, AP(1)) Clan Warrior, Hero,
